tasks.description: Freeze the Spring Boot 3.3.5 and Java 21 baseline and confirm current runtime health
tasks.requirements: Document the current application state, confirm Java 21 and Spring Boot 3.3.5 are in use, and establish the baseline for low-risk upgrades. Keep the project on the Boot 3.x line and avoid any major framework migration.

tasks.description: Secure configuration and separate runtime profiles for dev, test, and prod
tasks.requirements: Move database credentials, JWT secrets, and environment-specific values to environment variables or secret-backed configuration; create profile-specific property files; remove hard-coded secrets from source-controlled config files; ensure safe defaults and explicit production values.

tasks.description: Review and pin dependency versions to keep the Boot 3.3.x stack stable and predictable
tasks.requirements: Audit direct dependencies, confirm compatibility with Spring Boot 3.3.x, pin security-sensitive versions where needed, and ensure no unexpected transitive drift is introduced. Avoid large jumps outside the current major line.

tasks.description: Apply incremental patch/minor upgrades within the Spring Boot 3.x line only
tasks.requirements: Upgrade to the latest stable Spring Boot 3.3.x patch release as appropriate, keep Java 21, and update Maven plugins only when compatible with the current runtime. Avoid Spring Boot 4 or cross-line upgrades during this modernization window.

tasks.description: Prove the application remains healthy after modernization changes
tasks.requirements: Run the full Maven verification flow, validate the health endpoint, and confirm the application starts in a controlled profile-driven environment without production secrets in source control.
